items.headline: Strong fantasy night in loss
items.text: Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding four rushes for 10 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

items.headline: Piles up yardage in Paris
items.text: Warren carried the ball 18 times for 101 yards and caught three of four targets for 36 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints.

items.headline: Cashes in goal-line TD in Week 7
items.text: Perine rushed four times for 16 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Ravens.

items.headline: Questionable for Sunday
items.text: Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.

items.headline: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text: London secured seven of 10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers on Sunday.

items.headline: Good to go for Week 8
items.text: Kelce (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Broncos.

items.headline: Practices fully Thursday
items.text: Diggs (hand/hamstring) was a full practice participant Thursday.

items.headline: Four catches in Week 7 win
items.text: Godwin secured four of five targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.

items.headline: Not available for Week 8
items.text: Henderson (illness) has been downgraded from questionable to out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of ESPN and NFL Network reports.

items.headline: Tosses one TD in Paris
items.text: Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers. He added seven rushing yards on three carries.

items.headline: Dealing with mild hamstring strain
items.text: McCaffrey is dealing with a mild hamstring strain rather than a quadriceps injury, and the 49ers believe he'll be ready following the team's Week 8 bye, David Lombardi of SF Standard reports.

items.headline: Efficient with expanded opportunity
items.text: Black rushed 12 times for 63 yards and a touchdown and brought in one of three targets for minus-4 yards in the 49ers' 29-20 loss to the Falcons on Sunday. He also lost a fumble and returned one kickoff for 34 yards.

items.headline: Red-zone struggles persist in Week 7
items.text: Brissett completed 27 of 48 passes for 272 yards and a touchdown while rushing seven times for 16 yards in Sunday's 30-16 loss to the Broncos.

items.headline: Upgrades to full practice Thursday
items.text: Allen (ankle) was a full participant at Thursday's practice.

items.headline: Quiet game in win over New Orleans
items.text: Bernard caught three of five targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints.

items.headline: No limitations Thursday
items.text: Chase (ankle) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

items.headline: Will play Sunday
items.text: McConkey (concussion) is off the injury report and will play in Sunday's game against the Rams, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Heavy workload as pass catcher Sunday
items.text: Kamara carried the ball six times for five yards and caught all seven of his targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

items.headline: Limited production in Week 7 win
items.text: Rodgers completed 19 of 30 passes for 212 passes and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints. He added six yards on three carries.

items.headline: Another TD in Week 7 win
items.text: Pitts brought in all five targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers on Sunday.

items.headline: Officially ruled out
items.text: Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

items.headline: Receiving TD with expanded role
items.text: White rushed seven times for 27 yards and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

items.headline: Increased usage on tap?
items.text: Coleman said Friday that he'll be ready for a larger role if that's what the team needs in the absence of RJ Harvey , who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Kansas City due to a knee injury, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

items.headline: Listed as questionable for Sunday
items.text: Waddle (chest) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chiefs after he was a limited participant in Friday's practice.

items.headline: Gets into end zone against Indy
items.text: Hockenson caught four of five targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

items.headline: Set for normal role despite trade request
items.text: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Friday that Downs will perform his usual role Sunday against Jacksonville in spite of the fact that he requested a trade this week, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Season high in receiving yards Sunday
items.text: Fannin caught six of nine targets for 91 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Titans.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Paris
items.text: Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 loss to the Steelers.

items.headline: Scores on both catches in return
items.text: Douglas (ankle) caught two of three targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.

items.headline: Trio of TDs in Week 7 win
items.text: Prescott completed 15 of 27 passes for 212 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for eight yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night. He also had a two-point conversion run.

items.headline: Solid production in Week 7 win
items.text: Robinson rushed 20 times for 63 yards and brought in all five targets for 59 yards in the Falcons' 29-20 win over the 49ers on Sunday.

items.headline: Grinds out yards, TD in win
items.text: Swift rushed 22 times for 78 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 12 yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.headline: Stellar numbers in lopsided loss
items.text: Flowers brought in eight of 11 targets for 137 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

items.headline: Modest numbers in Week 7 win
items.text: Jefferson caught four of seven targets for 44 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Colts.

items.headline: Bigger role on tap without Tate
items.text: Robinson and the other pass catchers will operate in elevated roles against the Bengals on Sunday due to the absence of rookie fourth overall pick Carnell Tate (shoulder), Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

items.headline: Back in end zone during win
items.text: Kraft secured all six targets for 53 yards and a touchdown in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.headline: Stretches TD streak to four games
items.text: Gordon rushed 25 times for 103 yards and a touchdown while catching one of three targets for no gain in Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.

items.headline: Tosses two TDs in Week 7 win
items.text: Goff completed 22 of 32 passes for 303 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers.

items.headline: Two long catches and TD in Week 7
items.text: Cooper caught all five of his targets for 115 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.

items.headline: Two TD passes in OT loss
items.text: Stroud completed 17 of 28 passes for 153 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants. He added two rushing attempts for four yards and threw a successful two-point conversion.

items.headline: Gets first TD with Texans
items.text: Harrison caught one of four targets for a six-yard touchdown in Sunday's 27-21 overtime loss to the Giants.

items.headline: Could 'potentially' play in 2026
items.text: When asked Monday if Conner (foot) will play this season, coach Mike LaFleur said "potentially," Dani Sureck of the Cardinals' official site reports.

items.headline: Still targeting December return
items.text: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Friday that Pacheco (back) has a chance to return in late December, Justin Rogers of DetroitFootball.net reports.

items.headline: Shut down for second straight game
items.text: Henry rushed 17 times for 45 yards and brought in one of two target for four yards in the Ravens' 35-13 loss to the Bengals on Sunday.

items.headline: Pair of TDs in primetime win
items.text: Jacobs rushed 21 times for 39 yards and a touchdown and brought in all six targets for 13 yards and another score in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.headline: Suffers broken rib Thursday
items.text: Watson said he suffered a broken rib in Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Logs full practice Thursday
items.text: St. Brown (ankle) practiced in full Thursday.

items.headline: Hits 400-catch mark in season-best outing
items.text: McBride caught 10 of 13 targets for 111 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-16 loss to the Broncos.

items.headline: Huge day against Titans
items.text: Concepcion caught eight of 10 targets for 129 yards and added 23 yards on three carries in Sunday's 27-24 win over Tennessee.

items.headline: Sharing backfield with Jones vs. Detroit
items.text: Mason and Aaron Jones (knee) will share the backfield against the Lions on Sunday after the latter avoided an injury designation for Week 8, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

items.headline: Solid numbers in high-scoring win
items.text: Allen completed 23 of 33 passes for 255 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed five times for one yard in the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

items.headline: Career-high rushing yardage in win
items.text: Williams rushed 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

items.headline: Gets into end zone Sunday
items.text: Shakir brought in four of six targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in the Bills' 33-30 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

items.headline: Four catches in Week 7 win
items.text: Flournoy secured all four targets for 70 yards in the Cowboys' 38-21 win over the Eagles on Monday night.

items.headline: Garners 58 total yards in win
items.text: Brown rushed 11 times for 39 yards and brought in four of five targets for 19 yards in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

items.headline: Stays hot in Week 9 win
items.text: Love completed 30 of 41 passes for 288 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and recovered a fumble in the Packers' 27-19 win over the Panthers on Thursday.

items.headline: Stymied by Seattle's elite front
items.text: Walker rushed 14 times for 36 yards while catching four of five targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks.

items.headline: Rushing totals continue to dip
items.text: Hampton rushed seven times for 18 yards and caught all four of his targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

items.headline: Disappointing production in Week 7
items.text: Higbee caught two of three targets for 14 yards during Sunday's 35-21 win over the Raiders.

items.headline: Season-best effort in win
items.text: Burden brought in all four targets for 130 yards and a touchdown and rushed once for seven yards in the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday.

items.headline: Rumbles for 100 yards, TD
items.text: Wilson rushed 24 times for 100 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 15 yards in Sunday's 20-3 win over the Chiefs.

items.headline: Dominant performance in second half
items.text: Burrow completed 22 of 30 passes for 292 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for 12 yards in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens on Sunday.

items.headline: Big volume in win over Saints
items.text: Dowdle carried the ball nine times for 41 yards and caught all six of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over New Orleans.

items.headline: Ready to return in Week 8
items.text: Love (ankle) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game at Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Denies trade request talk
items.text: Wilson said Wednesday that he won't ask to be traded from the Jets, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Full practice Thursday
items.text: Bowers (calf) was a full practice participant Thursday.

items.headline: Three total TDs in Week 7 win
items.text: Willis completed 14 of 21 passes for 208 yards and two touchdowns while rushing six times for 39 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 28-25 win over the Jets.
